import json, os, collections
p = r\"C:\\Users\\hzq00\\.codex\\sessions\\2026\\08\\10\\rollout-2026-08-10T16-32-17-019feacd-184e-7472-9f11-ea364c22e595.jsonl\"
print(\"size\", os.path.getsize(p))
types = collections.Counter()
first = None
with open(p, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:
    for line in f:
        try: obj = json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        t = obj.get(\"type\") or (obj.get(\"payload\") or {}).get(\"type\")
        types[t] += 1
        if first is None: first = obj
print(dict(types))
print(json.dumps(first, ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
'@ | python -"
